findings.passage: As we heard yesterday, Wisconsin’s kids, our future, relies on common-sense gun safety bills. With universal background checks, extreme risk protection orders, and incentives for stronger storage, we move toward minimizing gun violence across our state.
findings.note: Remarks in her own press release (official Assembly site) after a gun-safety coalition press conference. She names universal background checks, extreme risk protection orders and storage incentives.

findings.passage: I’m proud to support these common sense bills and am calling upon my colleagues to schedule a hearing so that Wisconsinites have an opportunity to have their voices heard by their representatives.
findings.note: Same release. She says she supports the gun-safety bills and asks for a committee hearing on them.

findings.passage: Last session I co-authored bills that addressed bipartisan concerns around school safety, gun safety, and mental health because Wisconsinites should not have to worry about the safety of their loved ones in school or in our communities.
findings.note: From her statement on the creation of the Office of Violence Prevention. Says she co-authored gun safety bills in the prior session and wants to keep preventing gun violence. [kept from the first search pass]
